detail.longDescription: An AI game agent can press the correct key and still be wrong. A keypress proves what the agent attempted—not what the game actually did. In WindowsAgent, I split the runtime into three loops: fast control, evidence indexing, and high-level planning and skill development. The goal is an agent whose skills are verifiable, stoppable, replayable, and repairable. https:// ronniewong.cc/en/blog/ai-game- agent-three-line-runtime-3bdc1b36/ # GameAI # AIAgents # LLM
